details.investigated: Gumroad's thumbnail/cover-image upload endpoints, to close the deferred cover-image gap from the 2026-09-02/03 publish builds
details.method: Read Gumroad's actual production Rails source directly (config/routes.rb, app/controllers/api/v2/thumbnails_controller.rb, covers_controller.rb, direct_uploads_controller.rb) via WebFetch -- same discipline as every prior Gumroad fix, not CLI docs or WebSearch summaries
details.findings: POST /v2/products/:id/thumbnail and POST /v2/products/:id/covers both accept either a signed_blob_id (standard Rails ActiveStorage direct upload) or a plain url, gated by the already-granted edit_products scope. Unlike the digital ZIP file (which needed the separate S3-multipart /v2/files flow because /v2/direct_uploads rejects non-media content types), a PNG image IS exactly what /v2/direct_uploads accepts -- so the standard direct-upload flow works directly here, no new workaround needed.

details.mechanism: POST /v2/direct_uploads (blob metadata + base64 MD5 checksum) -> PUT bytes to the returned presigned URL -> POST /v2/products/:id/thumbnail with the resulting signed_blob_id. Idempotent (no-ops if status/gumroad_listing.json.thumbnail_uploaded is already true, or if no product_id exists yet).

summary: Per owner instruction, investigated whether the AI itself could reach Gumroad's view/traffic data via any official route (public page, another API resource, an admin/insights endpoint) before proposing any human-only fallback. Read Gumroad's production source directly: the only views/traffic surface found, AnalyticsController, inherits from Sellers::BaseController and is gated by a logged-in seller's web session/cookie (Pundit policy checks against session context), not the OAuth v2 API this project's access token uses. Cross-checked against the documented API v2 scopes (edit_products, view_sales, view_profile, mark_sales_as_shipped, refund_sales) -- no analytics/views scope exists among them. Combined with the already-confirmed absence of a views field on the GET /v2/products/:id response itself (see the prior binding_constraint_rediagnosis_correction event) and this sandbox's confirmed zero egress to gumroad.com, concluded this is a genuine technical dead end, not merely unconfirmed. Queued exactly one low-priority, one-time human ask in status/CURRENT_STATUS.json.human_actions_required, per the owner's explicit condition that a human fallback should only follow real verification of infeasibility.

summary: Owner reviewed the confirmed real-voice test post and approved resuming automatic X posting, explicitly as a judgment-gated system rather than a daily-streak poster: post only on days with a genuinely new fact/change/failure/decision, never filler, never a same-topic rehash, max 1/day, always a direct reply to X_ROOT_POST_ID, no auto-replies to other users or DMs, every post grounded in the 3 voice-corpus files with register C prioritized, a Voice-fingerprint self-check every time, results recorded to GitHub, same-day idempotency maintained.
